headline: KV-streams improve context compaction efficiency
body: Longer context traces strain GPU memory, and existing compaction methods require repeated prefilling, slowing training. KV-streams aim to reduce this bottleneck while keeping memory usage steady.
caption:
KV-streams improve context compaction efficiency

Longer context traces strain GPU memory, and existing compaction methods require repeated prefilling, slowing training. KV-streams aim to reduce this bottleneck while keeping memory usage steady.
